Roll the WAL, the state and the archive back to a block the WAL holds

Usage: dolos sync rollback [OPTIONS] --slot <SLOT> --hash <HASH>

Options:
      --slot <SLOT>      The slot of the block to roll back to
      --hash <HASH>      The hash of the block to roll back to
      --yes              Go ahead with what the command destroys
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  
  -h, --help             Print help
